description: Phase 4 MerLin ADAPTATION (not the paper's model): 6 modes, N photons (default 2; --n-photons 3), U-z-U-z-U re-uploading, threshold detection with collision-free postselection; group readout P_k(+1) = 1/4 + 3/4 n_(G_k) / N (bias exact; provably noncontextual).
